column1: # What you decided on past runs. One row per item, tab-separated, newest last.
# decision: keep or user handles (not proposed again before the recheck date),
#   ask (another agent session owns it: the row stays out of rec and says whom to ask;
#   put the session's name first in the note, then a colon),
#   removed (history only; something that regrows is proposed again on its merits).
# recheck: YYYY-MM-DD, never, or free text (anything but a past date keeps holding).
# path: the folder or file, ~ allowed. Rows without a real path are notes for the agent.

column5: build-session: its cargo cache; ask in agent-chat
